name: mcp-cookidoo
description: Search Cookidoo recipes and manage your own: custom recipes with Thermomix settings, shopping list, meal plan, collections.
long_description: Unofficial MCP server for the Thermomix Cookidoo platform, not affiliated with Vorwerk. It logs in with your Cookidoo e-mail and password (Cookidoo has no OAuth), so use a unique password. Recipes are checked against what your Thermomix (TM5, TM6, TM7) supports. Recipe content from Cookidoo is treated as data, not instructions; keep Claude's approval prompt on for tools that change your account.

email.title: Cookidoo e-mail
email.description: The e-mail address you log in to Cookidoo with.

password.title: Cookidoo password
password.description: Stored by Claude Desktop in your system's secure storage. Use a password you use nowhere else.

country.title: Cookidoo country
country.description: Country code of your Cookidoo site, e.g. ch, de, at, fr, gb.

language.title: Cookidoo language
language.description: Language of your Cookidoo site, e.g. de-CH, de-DE, fr-FR, en-GB. Thermomix settings are written in it (German, French, English).

device.title: Thermomix
device.description: TM5, TM6 or TM7. Leave empty to detect it from the devices linked to your account.

image_dir.title: Recipe photo folder
image_dir.description: Optional: the only folder recipe photos may be uploaded from. Leave empty to disable photo upload.
